review.reason: Obtain real source-word provenance that old artifacts lack, then check generic corridor reconciliation and ID-bound German translation

review.outputs: dubbing_naturalness_2026-10-28/source_validation_2026-10-29/gpu_smoke.json and gpu_full.json; source words, original and reconciled turns, ID-linked translations, voice hints, diagnostics, timing, provenance; raw alignment receipts committed to cache volume

review.purpose: Evaluate the shared bounded natural dubbing pipeline on the just-produced source-linked German units
review.reason: Measure native speech, conservative edge padding and whole-turn feasibility on real source-linked inputs; preserve native takes for listening even if a finished timeline cannot be produced
review.input: Exactly derived gpu_full.json from the GPU producer. Smoke the first whole CRISPR source unit, then all units of the three cases serially. review.outputs: New dubbing_naturalness_2026-10-28/source_validation_2026-10-29/cpu_smoke and cpu_full directories: reports, hash-checked native WAV takes (bounded64MiB per stage), and per-case final WAV only when all its timing constraints pass. No existing media overwritten; no new video packaging, source-audio extraction or background separation locally.
review.quality_tradeoffs: Uses unchanged shared algorithm: native speed first, maximum1.15x, no slowdown, conservative outer-padding removal, no post-tempo trimming. Infeasible translation returns needs_revision and diagnostics; evaluation can fail honestly without a finished dub. Native presets are not voice clones. No semantic guarantee or automatic rewriting.
